issues.description: The rendered typography is consistently wider and larger than the source. The subtitle and all six body lines show the strongest expansion, while the main title and card titles are also wider and slightly heavier; this changes the title-to-body hierarchy, baseline positions, and line rhythm across the whole slide.

changes.instruction: Retune the title, subtitle, card-title, and card-body font face/size/weight/metrics against the source, with priority on reducing subtitle and body-text width and restoring their source baselines.

issues.description: The source uses a subtly modulated near-white background and larger off-canvas corner arcs, whereas the render uses a uniform gray-blue field with smaller, more self-contained ellipses. The difference is visible but does not disturb the card hierarchy.

changes.instruction: Match the source's subtle background tonal modulation and resize/reposition both decorative ellipses so their arcs enter from and extend beyond the corresponding corners.

background_seams.rationale: No hard rectangular crop seam or discontinuous decorative-layer join is visible; the remaining background difference is a smooth style mismatch captured separately.

connector_endpoints.rationale: The source has no arrowheads or node-to-node connector endpoints; the visible horizontal rules intentionally terminate within each card.

connector_topology.rationale: The source contains no semantic process connectors, branches, merges, or cycles; the six short horizontal rules are decorative dividers.

crop_boundaries.rationale: All six icons retain their intended pale rounded-square tiles without leaked rectangular corners, opaque halos, or clipping not present in the source.

key_proportions.rationale: The two-by-three card grid, card dimensions, icon-tile scale, internal spacing, and overall visual balance closely match the source.

typography_hierarchy.rationale: The render expands and enlarges the subtitle and body copy and also widens the title tiers, producing a slide-wide mismatch in scale, density, and baselines.

visual_depth.rationale: The render preserves the source's simple layered hierarchy of page field, corner decorations, white cards, blue borders, icon tiles, and dividers; no multiple depth cues are flattened at once.
